stories.title: Trump and Michael Cohen reunite for first public conversation in 8 years
new_facts: Confirms Trump and Cohen actually reconciled and spoke publicly on Thursday, completing the previously anticipated interview.
Cohen's 2019 congressional testimony called Trump a racist, conman, cheat and mobster; interview was a call-in to 77 WABC radio.
Only a 15-minute snippet aired Thursday; full interview airs in entirety on WABC Sunday.
Interview covered substantive topics including Iran and the economy, not just personal reconciliation.
Cohen once called himself Trump's 'attack dog with a law license' and previously used the term 'predator' for Trump.
Trump claimed in the interview he would win by 25 points if he ran for a third term.
Cohen previously called Trump a 'Cheeto-dusted cartoon villain'.
stories.line: Trump and his former fixer Michael Cohen spoke publicly for the first time in eight years on Cohen's radio show.
